messages:
morgan: Quick onboarding check — uploaded sage-mini-v2 weights and tokenizer? seeing weird off-by-one in chat prompts. Anyone pick this up? :thinking:
lee: I uploaded weights to gs://redwood-models/sage-mini-v2/weights/ and the manifest is at gs://redwood-models/sage-mini-v2/manifest.json sha256:abc123def. Run `gsutil ls gs://redwood-models/sage-mini-v2/**` to verify.
ana: I think the tokenizer map has two special tokens: "<sys>" and "<|sys|>" — both map to id 2 which causes prefix trimming to remove the system prompt token sometimes.
morgan: ugh — is that from conversion pipeline or model repo?
lee: conversion output. We used openconverter v0.9 which for chat templates introduced an extra sentinel. Fix: enable a dedupe_special_tokens step in convert config. Example snippet: ```json
{
  "dedupe_special_tokens": true,
  "special_tokens": ["<sys>","<|sys|>","<resp>"]
}
```
ana: CI validator shows: "prompt_template_validation: disallowed duplicate special_token mapping" — current model config has both tokens. Quick repro: `python -m runcore.check_config --model-dir gs://redwood-models/sage-mini-v2`
devops-bot: deploy-checker: ingestion job for sage-mini-v2 failed 1/3 checks (config). See https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1234
sam: Note for serving runtime: our BOS/EOS handling expects start_token id 1 and end_token id 2. If dedupe shifts ids we need to pin preserve_bos_eos in model config so runtime behavior stays stable. Suggested addition to model.yaml: ```
preserve_bos_eos: true
bos_id: 1
eos_id: 2
```
lee: I can re-run converter with dedupe and preserve flags and push a new manifest. Will do in ~30m. tagging @morgan @ana :eyes:
morgan: can we also add a tiny sanity prompt to onboarding test? maybe: "system: Provide brief JSON with 1-2 fields" then user: "what's the plan?"
lee: will add eval prompt and a token-count check in integration tests. sample tokenization before fix: "system: hi" -> [50256, 3, 234] (counts looked like 3 tokens)
ana: that missing token is the duplicate sentinel getting suppressed. after dedupe tokenization = expected 4 tokens.
jordan: i'll review the PR once lee pushes. ping me for code review. :thumbsup:
maria: timeline? if lee pushes fix now, can we canary by EOD?
lee: yes — pushing in 35m, canary in staging for 2 hours, then prod tomorrow morning if green.
morgan: thanks all. I'll update the model card (weights path, manifest sha, special-token notes) and mark readiness checklist when CI passes. tagging @jordan for review reminder tomorrow 09:00 PT.
lee: pushing now. devops-bot: starting preflight. :rocket:
